What is the loan origination process?: Loan origination is the multi-step process of applying, evaluating, verifying, and disbursing a new loan.
How do I apply for a loan?: You can apply for a loan online through our portal, by chatting with this assistant, or by visiting our nearest branch.
What is the first step of loan applicati: The first step is submitting your application details, income proof, and identity documents for preliminary checks.
What is credit verification?: Credit verification is the process where bank officers check your credit score, employment status, and financial history.
What is physical verification?: Physical verification is when bank representatives visit your residence or workplace to confirm your details.
What is technical valuation?: Technical valuation is when a bank engineer inspects a property to determine its market value and structural condition.
What is legal verification?: Legal verification is the review of property title deeds and ownership documents by the bank's legal team to ensure a clear title.
What is a sanction letter?: A sanction letter is an official document from the bank confirming in-principle approval of your loan, stating terms and conditions.
What is a disbursement?: Disbursement is the final step where the approved loan amount is transferred to the builder, seller, or borrower's bank account.
What is a partial disbursement?: A partial disbursement occurs in home construction loans, where funds are released in stages based on the construction progress.
What is loan underwriting?: Underwriting is the detailed risk analysis performed by credit experts to decide whether to approve or reject a loan application.
How long does home loan approval take?: A Home Loan approval usually takes 7 to 10 working days, subject to clear legal and technical verification of the property.
How long does personal loan approval tak: Personal Loans are typically approved and disbursed within 24 to 48 hours as they require minimal documentation and no collateral.
What is in principle approval?: In-principle approval is a preliminary approval based on your income and credit score, subject to property checks.
What is a loan agreement?: A loan agreement is the legal contract signed by the borrower and the bank detailing repayment terms, interest rates, and charges.
What is KYC?: KYC stands for Know Your Customer, a mandatory process to verify your identity and address using PAN, Aadhaar, or Passport.
What is eKYC?: eKYC is a paperless, digital verification of identity using Aadhaar-based OTP or biometric authentication.
What is a welcome letter?: A welcome letter is sent after disbursement, containing your loan account number, EMI schedule, and customer portal login details.
What is NACH mandate?: NACH (National Automated Clearing House) mandate is a form you sign to authorize automatic deduction of EMIs from your bank account.
Can I change my EMI deduction date?: Yes, you can request to change your EMI deduction date by visiting the branch and submitting a fresh NACH mandate.
What is credit appraisal?: Credit appraisal is the assessment performed by the bank's credit department to evaluate your repayment capacity.
How do I close my loan?: To close your loan, visit the branch, pay off any outstanding dues, and collect your original property documents and a No Dues Certificate.
What is a No Dues Certificate?: A No Dues Certificate (NDC) or No Objection Certificate (NOC) is an official letter from the bank stating that the loan is fully paid.
How long does it take to get property do: The bank typically returns all original property documents within 15 to 21 working days after the loan is successfully closed.
Why would a loan application be rejected: Applications are rejected due to low CIBIL scores, high existing debts, insufficient income, or issues in property legal verification.
